instruction: Get the instructor-embedding repository from https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding and save it to /home/user.

metadata.explanation: Task requires downloading the instructor-embedding repository from https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding to /home/user. Evaluator verifies the download was successful by checking: (1) at least 10 Python files exist, (2) .git directory is present, (3) git remote URL matches the expected repository, and (4) README.md exists to confirm repository structure.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator comprehensively verifies repository download by checking Python file count (min 10 files)
Correctly verifies repository integrity by checking .git directory exists
Validates correct source by comparing git remote URL with expected repository (https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding)
Confirms repository structure by verifying README.md exists
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter (directly accesses expected.get('min_count') and expected.get('expected_repo_url'), which is correct for type='rule')
URL normalization logic handles both https and git protocols, with or without .git suffix
All checks must pass for success (returns 1.0 only if all conditions met), ensuring complete verification
Getter extracts all necessary state: file count, git directory, remote URL, and key files
